description:
Activate Firemind Vessel by tapping it, two mana of different colors.
Activate Voltaic Key by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting Firemind Vessel.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Voltaic Key's ability, targeting Voltaic Key.
Resolve both Voltaic Key abilities, untapping it and Firemind Vessel.
Repeat.

uses.name: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment
